title: Independent verification (no κ): #2447's owner fill is exactly the certified optimum for #2435's words; the same optimum in 4 role moves (fewer charts)
body:
**Independent verification plus a minimal alternative construction; no κ claim.**

[#2442](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2442) certified the bin-pattern integer optimum for [#2435](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2435)'s T74 words: idle `{1:20822, 3:6694, 5:2, 48:25302}`, root 0.0016985119240027768. Every legal whole-helper fill has b at most that plus 1e-15. [#2447](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2447) (Jeremy Kothe) claims κ = 0.001698511924002761… with "the pattern-optimal fill".

**1. #2447's fill checked independently, and provably optimal.**
- #2447's pinned map (head `805bbadd`) passes this author's independent checker (#2387 `fill_check80`, no shared code) for every rule:
  - R-a..R-e, with windows rebuilt from GLOBAL-TEMPLATE;
  - R-f, physical stock 66,826;
  - R-g, X2 pending axes, with 9,531 charts equal to its SPEC.
- Its recount equals its SPEC and PROFILE.
- Its idle multiset is exactly #2442's certified optimum, and its κ equals the optimum root within 1e-15.
- With #2442, this makes #2447's fill **provably optimal** for these words: no owner map can gain more than 1e-15.

**2. The same optimum with 4 role moves.** Independently, four role moves on #2435's pinned map (`MOVES.json`) reach the same optimum. #2447 changes 287,264 rows.

| bin | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| A (48) | [8,8,9,9,9] + 5 | [4,8,9,9,9,9] |
| B (48) | [9,9,9,9,9] + 3 | [4,8,9,9,9,9] |
| C (32) | [4,9,9,9] + 1 | [9,9,9] + 5 |
| D (32) | [4,9,9,9] + 1 | [9,9,9] + 5 |

- The 4-move map passes R-a..R-g, with its root certified within 1e-15 of the optimum: +5.80e-10 over #2435.
- It needs **9,131 distinct 73-column charts**, against 9,531 for #2447. That can only help the invoice row bound, which was not re-run.
- **Controls:**
  - #2435's own map reproduces its idle multiset and root.
  - Each single move alone fails (capacity) or misses the optimum.
  - An out-of-window move is rejected (R-d).
  - A same-call family clash is rejected (R-e).

**Checks.** `--check-only`, the 3.10 grammar check and the research tests pass. Run on CPython 3.14.4; the registered 3.12 replay was not run.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/t74-2435-optimal-owner-map/optimal_map.py --fetch   # ~30 s
# PASS_T74_2435_OPTIMAL_MAP moves=4 idle={"1":20822,"3":6694,"48":25302,"5":2} root=0.0016985119240028 gain=+5.803e-10 charts=9131 controls=6 pr2447=verified no_new_kappa
```

**Scope.**
- No κ claim for the 4-move map: #2435's admission was not re-run with the new chart count.
- #2447's κ formula and admission are its own; only its map, recount and endpoint are checked.
- The entrance-raise delivery obligation is inherited (#2446/#2453).
- Base: main `0fdd7d82`. Assignment: complex-supplier track, seed 28.
